director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
mujhe nahi pata
Aaj hum kaagaz ke tester se kone jaanchenge, aur string se circle banayenge. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi, aap batao

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Ludo board ka kona dekho. Kaagaz ko do baar modo, toh bilkul aisa kona banta hai: yeh hamara tester hoga. Yeh ek square hai. Iska har kona kitaab ke kone jaisa hai; aise kone ko right angle kehte hain. Is square ke saare kone ek jaise hain. Is square mein kul kitne right angle hain?
director.card: Is square ke saare kone ek jaise hain. Is square mein kul kitne right angle hain?

seams.form: Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon.

director.text: 4 hai na

Bilkul sahi: square ke 4 kone, aur har kona right angle. Do baar mode kaagaz ka kona right angle hai; yahi tester hai. Tester kisi kone mein bilkul fit ho, koi khaali jagah na bache, toh woh kona right angle hai. Board par ek aaram kursi ka kona bana hai: peeth aur seat ke beech ka. Kya yeh kona right angle hai?
director.card: Board par ek aaram kursi ka kona bana hai: peeth aur seat ke beech ka. Kya yeh kona right angle hai?

director.text: sahi nahi

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki aaram kursi ke kone mein tester rakho toh beech mein khaali jagah bachegi, isliye woh kona right angle nahi hai. Yeh do ek jaise square hain: pehla seedha rakha hai, doosra ghumaya hua hai. Ghumane se square ki disha badli; uske kone ab kaise hain, yeh tester se jaanchenge. Kya ghumaye hue square ke kone ab bhi right angle hain?
director.card: Kya ghumaye hue square ke kone ab bhi right angle hain?

director.text: yes, they are

Sahi jawab. Ghumaya hua square wahi square hai, toh uske kone ab bhi right angle hain. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Sonu ki ek tile tirchi lagi hai. Usne tester seedha rakha toh fit nahi hua, aur Sonu bola: is tile ka kona right angle nahi hai. Tester tirchi tile ke kone par seedha rakhoge, ya tile ke saath ghuma kar?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao

batting
Wah, batting! Toh yeh tumhe achha lagta hai. Chalo, ab padhai aage badhate hain. Tester tirchi tile ke kone par seedha rakhoge, ya tile ke saath ghuma kar?

director.text: samajh nahi aaya

Tester ko bhi tile jitna ghumao, taaki uska kona tile ke kone par aaye aur uske dono seedhe kinaare tile ki bhujaon ke saath padein. Ghuma kar rakhne par tester tile ke kone mein bilkul fit hua; beech mein koi khaali jagah nahi bachi. Tumhari baari: toh kya Sonu theek keh raha tha?
director.card: Tumhari baari: toh kya Sonu theek keh raha tha?

director.text: Hindi mein bolo
Haan, Hindi mein sunati hoon. Ghumaya hua tester us kone mein poora baith gaya. Ab batao, Sonu sahi tha kya?
director.card: Ghumaya hua tester us kone mein poora baith gaya. Ab batao, Sonu sahi tha kya?

director.text: theek nahi

Bilkul sahi: Sonu ka tester seedha tha aur tile tirchi, isliye fit nahi hua tha; ghumane se tile ka kona nahi badla. Toh poora jawab: tile ka kona right angle hai; Sonu ki baat theek nahi thi. Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo. Samose ki nok, pizza ke tukde ki nok, ya ek tirchi rakhi kitaab ka kona: inmein se right angle kaunsa hai?
director.card: Samose ki nok, pizza ke tukde ki nok, ya ek tirchi rakhi kitaab ka kona: inmein se right angle kaunsa hai?

director.text: phir se bolo

director.text: kitaab

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki samose aur pizza ki nok patli hain; tirchi kitaab ka kona ghumane se nahi badla, woh right angle hai. Ek square carrom board ko ghuma kar tircha rakha. Zoya ka kehna hai ki ab uske sirf do kone right angle hain. Kya Zoya ka kehna theek hai?
director.card: Ek square carrom board ko ghuma kar tircha rakha. Zoya ka kehna hai ki ab uske sirf do kone right angle hain. Kya Zoya ka kehna theek hai?

director.text: No hai na

Sahi jawab. Carrom board square hai, aur ghumane se uske chaaron kone right angle hi rehte hain, sirf do nahi. Ek square patang hawa mein tirchi ud rahi hai. Uske upar wale kone par tester patang ke saath ghuma kar rakho: kona kam khula niklega, bilkul fit hoga, ya zyada?
director.card: Ek square patang hawa mein tirchi ud rahi hai. Uske upar wale kone par tester patang ke saath ghuma kar rakho: kona kam khula niklega, bilkul fit hoga, ya zyada?

director.text: baith jayega

Bilkul sahi: patang square hai, toh tirchi udne par bhi uska har kona right angle hai; ghuma kar rakha tester bilkul fit hoga. Ab woh kone dekhenge jo tester mein fit nahi hote, jaise cake ki nok, aur unhe right angle se milayenge. Ab tak samajh aaya?
mujhe lagta hai haan

Tester ka kona kone par, seedha kinaara bhuja par. Doosri bhuja seedhe kinaaron ke beech ho toh right angle se kam, doosre kinaare par toh barabar, paar ho toh zyada. Yeh cake ke tukde ki nok hai. Is par tester rakhoge, toh nok right angle se kam khuli niklegi ya zyada?
director.card: Yeh cake ke tukde ki nok hai. Is par tester rakhoge, toh nok right angle se kam khuli niklegi ya zyada?

director.text: zyada

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Zyada tab hota jab doosri bhuja tester ke doosre seedhe kinaare ke us paar jaati; board par dekho ki woh kahan se jaati hai. Board wali cake ki nok right angle se kam khuli hai, ya zyada khuli?
director.card: Yeh cake ke tukde ki nok hai. Is par tester rakhoge, toh nok right angle se kam khuli niklegi ya zyada?

director.text: zyada
Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Tester ka kona nok ke kone par aur ek seedha kinaara ek bhuja par socho, aur dekho ki doosri bhuja kahan se jaati hai. Chalo, ab tumhari baari.
director.card: Yeh cake ke tukde ki nok hai. Is par tester rakhoge, toh nok right angle se kam khuli niklegi ya zyada?

director.text: kam khuli niklegi

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki tester rakho toh doosri bhuja dono kinaaron ke beech jaayegi. Angle khulne se bada hota hai, bhujaon ki lambai se nahi. A ki bhujayein chhoti hain, B ki lambi, par tester rakho toh dono par bilkul fit hoga: dono barabar. Board par do angle dekho: ek ki bhujayein 6 cm, doosre ki 12 cm. Kaunsa zyada khula hai?
director.card: Board par do angle dekho: ek ki bhujayein 6 cm, doosre ki 12 cm. Kaunsa zyada khula hai?

director.text: 12 cm wala

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Do pencil ko angle ki tarah pakdo. Ab dono ke aage ek-ek pencil jodo: bhujayein lambi ho gayi, par khulna wahi raha, toh angle bhi wahi raha. Do kitaabein khuli rakhi hain: ek ke panne 8 cm ke, doosri ke 16 cm ke. Kiska angle bada hai?
director.card: Do kitaabein khuli rakhi hain: ek ke panne 8 cm ke, doosri ke 16 cm ke. Kiska angle bada hai?

seams.form: Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: 8 cm wali kitaab

Bilkul sahi. 8 cm wali kitaab zyada khuli hai aur 16 cm wali kam, toh 8 cm wali ka angle bada hai. Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Board par 6 cm bhujaon wala aur 12 cm bhujaon wala angle hai; kiska khulna zyada hai?
director.card: Board par do angle dekho: ek ki bhujayein 6 cm, doosre ki 12 cm. Kaunsa zyada khula hai?

seams.form: Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: chhah cm wala

Sahi jawab, kyunki 6 cm wala zyada khula hai, 12 cm wala kam. Darwaza aur deewar bhi ek angle banate hain. Darwaza thoda kholo toh angle chhota, aur zyada kholo toh angle bada ho jaata hai. Board par ek gate hai jo 2 m chauda hai, aur ek darwaza jo 1 m chauda hai; dono khule hain. Kiska angle bada hai, ya dono barabar hain?
director.card: Board par ek gate hai jo 2 m chauda hai, aur ek darwaza jo 1 m chauda hai; dono khule hain. Kiska angle bada hai, ya dono barabar hain?

director.text: barabar hain

Haan, sahi hai. Suno, gate aur darwaza dono ek jitne khule hain, aur angle khulne se banta hai. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam karke hal karte hain. Rani ki rangoli mein teen kone hain, P, Q aur R, aur P ki bhujayein sabse lambi hain. Hamein inmein sabse bada angle dhoondhna hai. Pehle P ko lo: uska khulna right angle se kam hai ya zyada?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam karke hal karte hain.

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
P ki bhujaon ki lambai chhod do; board par uski doosri bhuja tester ke mukable kahan hai, sirf woh dekho. P ki bhujayein sabse lambi hain; tester se milao toh P right angle se kam khula hai ya zyada?
